result: Node-migration part of ruling #7441 done: the single-node test pinned, the migration cost measured on both CPU classes (a second node's segment, +4352 KiB at worst) and cut under RLIMIT_AS (worst need 45648 -> 43600 KiB, the before-realloc move 45648 -> 41296), with its own test; the spill itself not built in this run

gate.affected: 16 suites ok, 2058 passed / 0 failed, 9 conformance passed

rulings.item: Spill (the story's original part) not built: every spilled malloc would run the whole refill slow path (class stride is the constant CLASSES[c]), and a grow-path decision never fires in a heap that fits SEG_FIRST
rulings.recommendation: re-brief as HEAP-SPILL-COLD-3, measuring the per-spilled-malloc cost on a prototype first

rulings.item: Under a limit, a second node's first segment still maps 16 slabs against an 8-slab growth step (+2048 KiB at the move-after-malloc1 point)
rulings.recommendation: a smaller first mapping for a non-first segment under a limit, as a follow-up with layout-bin checks (touches take_slab, inlined in refill)

informational: Migration cost without a limit unchanged by design (VmSize only, no touched page): +4352 KiB when a node with no segment starts allocating while the first node's slabs sit idle

impact.what: the_heap_keeps_address_space_near_its_use no longer fails when the scheduler moves its child between NUMA nodes (pinned to one node)
least RLIMIT_AS over start, oracle moved to node 1 after malloc1 (Zen 1 and Skylake-SP)
least RLIMIT_AS over start, oracle moved to node 1 after refill (Zen 1 and Skylake-SP)
tests added (rt unit test, products migration test) and plants

improvement: Briefs that add a coordinator part to a Size S story should re-size it: two independent deliverables (a flaky-test ruling and a new allocator feature with kit counts on two CPU classes) do not fit 130 calls
next_step: Land the migration part; re-brief the spill as HEAP-SPILL-COLD-3
